comparison.objective: Operate a cup sealer to apply a proper seal; candidate adjusts and validates a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Cup/film alignment and sealer actuation versus captive-screw manipulation, collar tuning and guarded dynamic cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Cup must finish acceptably sealed without spill, misalignment or unsafe operation; candidate must stop a carriage twice within travel, force, rebound and drift limits.
comparison.reason: Machine operation is generic; sealing quality does not test adjustable damping or tool-mediated commissioning.
